question: Calculate the overall average first round and average last round of races missed by Formula 1 drivers across all years. Include only drivers who missed fewer than three races in a given year and who switched teams between their appearances immediately before and after their hiatus (i.e., the constructor ID for the race right before their first missed race must be different from the constructor ID for the race right after their last missed race in that year). Do not group results by year; return just the overall averages across the entire dataset.
sql:
WITH driven_rounds AS (
    SELECT year, driver_id, constructor_id, first_round, last_round
    FROM drives
    WHERE constructor_id != -1
),
driver_year_drives AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT year, driver_id, constructor_id, first_round, last_round
    FROM driven_rounds
),
all_rounds AS (
    SELECT year, round FROM races
),
driver_year_all_rounds AS (
    SELECT d.year, d.driver_id, r.round
    FROM driver_year_drives d
    JOIN all_rounds r ON d.year = r.year AND r.round BETWEEN d.first_round AND d.last_round
),
driver_year_stats AS (
    SELECT year, driver_id, COUNT(DISTINCT round) as num_driven_rounds
    FROM driver_year_all_rounds
    GROUP BY year, driver_id
),
year_total_rounds AS (
    SELECT year, COUNT(*) as total_rounds
    FROM races
    GROUP BY year
),
driver_year_missed AS (
    SELECT ds.year, ds.driver_id, yt.total_rounds - ds.num_driven_rounds as num_missed_rounds
    FROM driver_year_stats ds
    JOIN year_total_rounds yt ON ds.year = yt.year
    WHERE yt.total_rounds - ds.num_driven_rounds < 3
)
SELECT * FROM driver_year_missed ORDER BY year, num_missed_rounds LIMIT 20
